title: Tallahasse
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Dwight begins Sabre's new retail project under the leadership of Nellie Bertram, who reveals herself as president of special projects. Dwight humorously interacts with coworkers and faces a health crisis with appendicitis, leading to surgery. Post-surgery, he delivers a presentation on retail consumer habits and gains Nellie's interest. The team engages in various activities including a team-building exercise and group presentations. Nellie introduces Wally Amos, founder of Famous Amos Cookies, who brings cookies and attempts to give a speech, which is cut short by Erin's awkward interruption.

main_threads.thread: Dwight's involvement in Sabre's new retail project, his health crisis, and his efforts to prove leadership under Nellie Bertram.
